島の交易路 ― 強いAIと学ぶ資源と開拓のゲーム: Isle Routes — learn a resource-and-settling game with a strong AI
六角形の島で資源を集め、道・村・街を建てて10点を目指す4人ゲーム「島の交易路」: Isle Routes is a four-player game where you gather resources on a hexagonal island and build roads, villages and towns to reach 10 points. Play against a strong research AI and learn how to open and how to close out a game.
強いAIと学ぶ<span>島の交易路</span>: Learn Isle Routes with a strong AI
六角形の島で木材・れんが・羊毛・小麦・鉱石を集め、道・村・街を建てて先に10点を: A four-player game where you gather wood, brick, wool, grain and ore on a hexagonal island and build roads, villages and towns to be the first to 10 points. On this site you can play against a strong research AI and learn where to settle early and how to finish the game.
<a href=\"play.html\"><b>AIと対戦</b><small: Play the AIPlay a four-player game against three AIs. When unsure, see the move the AI recommends and its estimate of everyone's chances.
評価関数で1手先を見る「貪欲AI」に、この手番で勝てる筋を全部調べる読み切りを足: "Normal" is a greedy AI that looks one move ahead with an evaluation function, plus an exact search that never misses a win available this turn. "Strong" adds a search (MCTS) that samples dice rolls and hidden cards many times to look ahead. The research log is in EXPERIMENTS.md (Japanese).
「島の交易路」は、資源を集めて開拓する定番の4人ゲームの基本ルールに沿って作った: "Isle Routes" uses an original name and artwork made for this research, following the basic rules of the classic four-player resource-and-settling genre. Trading between players is not supported yet; you can trade with the bank and harbors only.
